instruction: Extract a 60-second audio clip starting at 1 minute from this music video. Save it as "Baby Justin Bieber clip.mp3" on the desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully opened terminal, listed desktop files to find the MP4, then used ffmpeg to convert 'Baby Justin Bieber.mp4' to MP3 with libmp3lame codec. Verified the output file (4.8MB) existed on the desktop. Completed in 8 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open terminal, use ffmpeg for media conversion with codec flags, handle file paths with spaces, verify file creation with ls
metadata.task_rationale: Adds complexity by requiring time-based trimming (-ss and -t flags) in addition to audio extraction, testing deeper ffmpeg knowledge while staying within demonstrated capabilities
metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting a 60-second audio clip from the MP4 starting at 1:00 mark. The video is ~219s long so 60s from 1:00 is valid (1:00-2:00). Custom getter runs ffprobe to check file properties. Metric verifies: file exists (0.3), audio-only (0.3), MP3 format (0.2), duration ~60s with tolerance (0.2).

scoring_breakdown.file_exists: 0.3 - Output MP3 clip file exists at expected path
scoring_breakdown.audio_only: 0.3 - File contains audio stream without video
scoring_breakdown.valid_duration: 0.2 - Audio duration is approximately 60 seconds (50-70s tolerance)

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly uses ffprobe to extract file existence, format, streams, duration, and codec from the output MP3 file path
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' - directly accesses expected.get('expected_formats') etc. from the rules dict
Partial credit scoring is well-structured: file exists (0.3), audio-only (0.3), MP3 format (0.2), duration 50-70s (0.2)
Output file path matches instruction requirement: /home/user/Desktop/Baby Justin Bieber clip.mp3
Duration tolerance of 50-70s for a 60-second clip is reasonable
Minor coverage gap: evaluator cannot verify the clip starts at the 1-minute mark (only checks duration). However, verifying exact start time would require audio fingerprinting which is impractical
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding a check that the source video duration is longer than 120s (1min start + 60s clip) to validate the clip could have been extracted from the correct range, though this is a minor enhancement
